description: Returns citywide counts, the date range, top crime types, and top location types for one city or all cities. The figures cover whole cities; get_area_trends covers a neighborhood.

city.description: City to summarize, or all for every city side by side.

top_n.description: Number of crime types and location types to list. Defaults to 10.

name: get_crime_stats
title: Citywide crime stats
